title: [SEP-1] User-signed discovery gossip ties a DID to the client's relay connection
description: Review finding SEP-1: User-signed discovery gossip ties a DID to the client's relay connection (lens SEP). Location: spec/10-relays.md:275, 298, 302; spec/02-identity.md:115, 163; vs spec/10-relays.md:500 ("I do not know who my users are"), ARCHITECTURE.md:88 (S1). Fix: As proposed. Nothing in the spec routes user-signed discovery records off the client's channel-carrying relay connection, and UserAd has no schema anywhere (grep shows only 10-relays:275, 298, 302). Q5 ("discovery records signed by whoever they describe") governs who signs a user record. It does not require that user records be gossiped or that clients publish them, so options (a) and (b) both fit Q5. Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/10-relays.md §10.3.1 Discovery topic (only SpaceAds/RelayAds; clients MUST NOT send DID-signed self records over relay); UserAd gone; spec/02-identity.md §2.7 IdentityChanged; spec/05-messaging.md §5.2.3 type table; ARCHITECTURE.md:371
